meta.title: JSON Validator - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Validate JSON syntax and get precise error messages with line numbers.
clickValidateMsg: Click Validate to check the CSV for issues.
steps_json-validator_1Desc: Paste the JSON you want to validate. The validator accepts any JSON structure — from simple key-value pairs to deeply nested API responses.
steps_json-validator_2Desc: Click Validate to check your JSON. Errors are highlighted with the exact line, column, and a description of what went wrong. Fix issues and re-validate.
steps_json-validator_3Desc: Once valid, copy the formatted JSON or download it. Use the validated data confidently in your application knowing it has correct syntax.
desc: Validate JSON syntax and get precise error messages with line numbers.
